title: The Wrath of God
lead: The Bible speaks often of God's anger (Hebrew 'aph and chemah; Greek orgē and thymos): against Israel's idolatry and injustice (Exodus 32:10; Deuteronomy 29:28), against proud nations (Isaiah 13:9), and at the last judgment (Romans 1:18; Revelation 6:16–17). It is pictured not as a bad temper but as God's settled opposition to evil, and the same books insist that he is "slow to anger" (Exodus 34:6).
